title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Maintain a transparent, documented privacy program that documents the organization's safeguards to address data privacy.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for authorizing, maintaining, and revoking data processing authorizations.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for reviewing, transferring, disclosing, modifying, or deleting data from the organization's information systems for privacy purposes.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for recording and maintaining an individual's privacy preferences.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for recording, maintaining, and reviewing stakeholder goals for data privacy.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for evaluating the organization's use of data for bias.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for recording and evaluating data provenance and lineage.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for limiting the identification or inference of individuals when processing data.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for replacing attribute values with attribute references in the organization's information systems for privacy purposes.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for informing customers and external business partners about how their data is being used and the organization's privacy goals.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process to obtain feedback from individuals regarding the organization's use of data and the associated privacy risks.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process to allow individuals to request corrections to their data.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process to allow individuals to request deletion of their data (right to be forgotten).

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the documented privacy program defines a process for sharing only appropriate data with third parties.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Maintain a technology platform to record the organization's efforts related to its data privacy program.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's privacy record system tracks individuals' stated privacy preferences.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's privacy record system tracks data correction and deletion requests and the organization's response.

title: Privacy Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's privacy record system tracks data disclosures or sharing of personal information with third parties.
